name: Design system
description: Entry point of the token pipeline. Three modifiers: theme (light, dark), density (comfortable, compact, touch) and motion (full, reduced). The apps choose the context at runtime; the generator produces all contexts.

theme.description: Light or dark. The setting appearance.theme also has the value 'system'; the app resolves it, not the resolver.

density.description: comfortable is the default on desktop and web, touch is fixed on mobile devices, compact is selectable on desktop.

motion.description: reduced follows the system setting 'Reduce motion' or the setting appearance.reduce_motion.
